summary: Xinyuan Real Estate filed a Form 6-K announcing routine board composition changes rather than a special situation. Mr. Yifan Li resigned as director effective April 27, 2026, and Mr. Yong Cui resigned effective May 12, 2026; the board appointed Mr. Jian Zhang as director effective July 8, 2026, per a duly executed board resolution. No price, stake, advisor, premium, or transaction terms were disclosed. Departures appear staggered and previously effective rather than abrupt forced removals, so no deal mechanics apply. What to watch: whether further board turnover signals governance stress at the China-based developer.
